race_context: The district: Daleville Community Schools serves Daleville and Salem Township in Delaware County, which is why the state list labels this race 'Salem Twp' {in_list}. The district says it has about 1,000 students in grades K-12 in two buildings: an elementary school and a junior/senior high school {dv_home}. Its staff directory lists Jason Callahan as superintendent and Dr. David Stashevsky as assistant superintendent {dv_staff}{amacad_callahan}.

Board: the Board of School Trustees has five members. They are Diane Evans (president, serving since 1986), Kip Corn (vice president, since 1999), Cassie Anthony (second vice president, since 2025), Vickie Rees (secretary, since 1988) and Ron Halbert Jr. (assistant secretary, since 2018) {dv_board}. County results list Daleville board races as at-large contests {dc_2022}{dc_2024}.

Election cycle: in 2022 voters chose two at-large members, re-electing Evans and Halbert unopposed {dc_2022}{sp_2022}. In 2024 they chose three, electing Kip A. Corn, Joseph (Joe) Kaelin and Vickie Rees {dc_2024}. The district later announced Kaelin's death and in spring 2025 sought candidates for an open board seat {dv_feed}. Anthony's board listing shows her serving since 2025 {dv_board}.

Seats on the 2026 ballot: by the four-year cycle, the two seats Evans and Halbert won in 2022 are up this year {dc_2022}. Evans is running again and Halbert is not on the 2026 list. Anthony is also on the list, although the seat Kaelin won in 2024 normally runs through 2028 {in_list}{dc_2024}. The state list shows 'vote for 1' {in_list}. This guide could not confirm how many seats are on the ballot or whether Anthony is running for a regular seat or to finish Kaelin's term. Voters should check their sample ballot.
Party labels: all three candidates are listed as Republicans {in_list}. Daleville candidates appeared without party labels (NP) in 2022 and 2024 {dc_2022}{dc_2024}.

Issues: this guide could not find 2025-26 Daleville board minutes, budget documents or news coverage of the board's decisions, including any effect of the 2025 property-tax law (SEA 1). The district's website did not show a board-minutes page this guide could reach.
Forums: this guide found no 2026 candidate forum, questionnaire or news coverage of this race.
